tools.name: request_competitive_hiring_report
tools.description: Emails one link to the work address given. The click creates a free VeritaHire account and opens the full Competitive Hiring Report for that posting: every employer hiring the same role within 25 miles by name, with the pay each posts and how fast each fills it, the last roles like it to close nearb

tools.name: is_job_still_open
tools.description: Whether a job posting is still on the employer's own careers site (VeritaHire re-reads employer sites and marks a posting closed within about 36 hours of it leaving): open, closed or unknown, with the last time it was confirmed. Works for any employer's posting, given its careers-site link.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "employers" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compare_job_posting · Public sink: hiring_market.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compare_job_posting · Public sink: hiring_market

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
